title: Dinkum
shortDescription: Dinkum is a survival life simulation game set on an island inspired by the rugged Australian outback. Farm, hunt, mine, fish, and forage to gather resources, expand your town, and discover what makes Dinkum so special—either solo or with friends.
zhShortDescription: 澳洲荒野版动物森友会——耕种、建造、探索。
description: G'Day! Grab your tools, gather resources, and build your town while hanging out with friends and enjoying the charm of Dinkum. A Survival Life Sim with Endless Possibilities Plant crops, raise animals, and build your dream farm, or roam the island catching fish and bugs at your own pace. With changing seasons and weather affecting how your crops grow, every day brings a new challenge. Slip on your flip-flops to hunt for rare fish, bugs, or ores. Every moment becomes a special adventure. Explore and Survive the Wild From red deserts and lush forests to hidden mines, Dinkum is full of wild places to explore. zhDescription: 《Dinkum》是设定在澳大利亚荒野的生活模拟游戏。在一片原始荒野中建立家园——耕种、钓鱼、采矿、捕虫，与动物村民交朋友。支持多人合作，和朋友们一起开荒。
metaDescriptionEn: Dinkum review — Australian-inspired farming and town-building. Crafting, exploration, multiplayer co-op.
metaDescriptionZh: 《金垦小镇》Steam 评测与介绍 — 澳洲风情农场模拟。开荒建造、探索、多人合作。
whyPlay: Dinkum is the Australian love letter to Animal Crossing and Stardew Valley you didn't know you needed. You build a town in the outback, befriend anthropomorphic Aussie animals, and gradually turn a dusty patch of land into a thriving community. The multiplayer makes it shine — building a town with friends while fending off crocs and collecting bugs is pure joy. It's the best 'cozy multiplayer' game on this list.
whyPlayZh: 《金垦小镇》是一封你没想到会需要的澳洲版动森+星露谷情书。在澳洲荒野里建造小镇，和拟人化的澳式动物交朋友，把一块荒地逐步变成繁荣社区。联机让它发光——和朋友一起建镇、打鳄鱼、抓虫子，纯粹的快乐。这是这份列表上最好的'休闲联机'游戏。
